validity.value: Photo must be recent, maximum 6 months old ("1 Recent passport size picture (max. 6 months old)" / "1 Photo récente (datée au maximum de 6 mois)")

file_spec.value: A recent passport-size photo is submitted with the application (by email, in advance, for review); the final biometric photo and fingerprints are then captured in person at the Embassy during the appointment (this in-person biometric capture step takes about 30 minutes)

cross_verification.note: Source is the official 'Requirements for a New Biometric Passport for Djibouti Nationals in the United States and Canada' bilingual (English/French) document published by the Embassy of the Republic of Djibouti in Washington, DC (Ministère des Affaires Étrangères et de la Coopération Internationale). It lists a recent passport-size photo (max. 6 months old) as a required document but does not give a numeric cm size, background color, or composition rules — biometric passports for this jurisdiction are issued by Djibouti's National Police based on data captured in person at the Embassy, which may explain the absence of a detailed citizen-facing photo spec. Third-party sites cite 35x35mm/white background/70% head-height figures, but these are excluded per the truthfulness gate as non-official.
